summary.en-US: Hand Firefox downloads to the Ultra Downloader app.

description.en-US:
Ultra Downloader is the companion extension for the Ultra Downloader desktop app on Windows.

When Ultra Downloader is running, clicking a download link or file-host Download button hands the URL to the app and cancels Firefox's own copy. If the app is not running, nothing is intercepted and Firefox downloads normally.

- Direct links and extensionless file-host buttons
- No popup, options page, history or analytics
- Local loopback connection only (127.0.0.1)
- Requires Ultra Downloader 1.2.0 or newer

release_notes.en-US: Initial release. Sends Firefox downloads to the Ultra Downloader desktop app when it is running.
